text:
Predicates:
EatSalads(x) ::: x eats salads regularly.
ConsciousAboutHealth(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GrewUpInHealthHome(x) ::: x grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) ::: x has good relationships with their parents.
VisitGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.
Taylor(x) ::: x is Taylor.
Premises:
∀x (EatSalads(x) → ConsciousAboutHealth(x) ∧ EatSalads(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUpInHealthHome(x) → EatSalads(x)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x) → GrewUpInHealthHome(x)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) → FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationshipWithParents(x) → ¬EatSalads(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitGym(x) → FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
(GrewUpInHealthHome(taylor) ∧ GoodRelationshipWithParents(taylor)) ⊕ ¬(GrewUpInHealthHome(taylor) ∨ GoodRelationshipWithParents(taylor)) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or it is true that Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor has a good relationship with her parents.
Conclusion:
VisitGym(taylor) ::: Taylor visits the gym at least once a day.
